displayName: Native shell with Flutter UI islands
statusNote: The native shell owns List, Selection, navigation, state, persistence and stream processing. One Flutter engine renders Detail and Insights. Flutter supports Android release add-to-app; its iOS simulator artifact is debug-only and is reported as island-flutter@debug.

android.uiToolkit: Jetpack Compose shell; Flutter Detail and Insights islands
android.runtime: ART native shell plus one lazy or prewarmed Flutter engine and Dart isolate
android.streamClient: native in-app replay of the bundled, golden-verified stream; WebSocket not implemented

ios.uiToolkit: UIKit shell; Flutter Detail and Insights islands
ios.runtime: Swift native shell plus one lazy or prewarmed Flutter engine and Dart isolate
ios.streamClient: native in-app replay of the bundled, golden-verified stream; WebSocket not implemented

R1.note: The Insights island is embedded in the installed artifact.

R2.reason: This candidate packages an embedded Flutter module; independently delivered Dart code is not implemented.

sync.reason: The production host-island transport is Flutter MethodChannel and asynchronous.

async.note: Host state snapshots, updates, markers and draw probes cross one JSON MethodChannel; the bridge micro-benchmark is not implemented.

crossRuntime.boundary: native host owns data and navigation; Flutter renders Detail and Insights from versioned JSON messages

deviations.description: The native host marker core and Flutter MethodChannel forwarder are candidate-local interim instrumentation.
deviations.impact: Results remain descriptive until the shared calibrated BenchKit and overhead experiment exist.

deviations.description: The native host replays the same golden-verified bundled stream on the absolute monotonic schedule.
deviations.impact: It compares only inside replay transport cells and is never pooled with server transport.

deviations.description: Flutter does not emit release-mode iOS simulator frameworks; the simulator candidate is explicitly island-flutter@debug.
deviations.impact: It is kept separate from release comparison cells.
